look_here_first: Unbranched spike of small purple discoid heads; use stem surface, corm, and fruit to teach local var. punctata versus var. mucronata.

infraspecific_lesson.Liatris punctata var. mucronata: Accepted variety; familiar Liatris mucronata concept; often glossy reddish stems locally.
infraspecific_lesson.Liatris punctata var. punctata: Accepted autonym variety; often grayer and more pubescent stems locally.
